Body.Content:
With AKS cluster autoscaling, customers can scale more efficiently and run their applications without downtime. Building on the upstream Kubernetes cluster autoscaler, AKS will automatically add new instances to the existing clusters when more capacity is required and remove them when they are no longer needed. When combined with the horizontal pod autoscaler, customers can precisely tune the scaling behavior of their environment. 

Learn more about AKS.
